source_documents.title: Modulating Heavy-Atom-Free Triplet-State Dynamics in Benzimidazole-Based D−π–A Molecules: Distinct Roles of Solvent Polarity and Protic Interactions

reference_evidence_units.quote: The transient absorption spectroscopy reveals that nitro-substituted BVI-NO2 in DMSO exhibits obvious intersystem crossing (ISC, 863.4 ps) and triplet-state population (1.53 μs), which is different from the other two molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC in 863 ps and a 1.53 us triplet; the OH and malononitrile analogues show none.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Concurrently, a new absorption band gradually emerges and intensifies in the region of 640 nm, which is assigned to the triplet−triplet absorption (TTA).
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: A 640 nm triplet-triplet absorption grows in with an isosbestic point.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Therefore, the long-lived component observed in the ns-TA spectra confirms the formation of the triplet excitons in BVI-NO2, indicating that nitro substitution effectively facilitates ISC and promotes triplet exciton population.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2

reference_evidence_units.quote: Theoretical calculation demonstrates that nitro substitution enables a favorable S1(π, π) → T4(n, π*) transition, triggering the absence of the ISC channel in hydroxyl and malononitrile molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2 vs analogues
reference_evidence_units.statement: An El-Sayed-allowed S1(pi-pi*) to T4(n-pi*) channel exists only with the nitro group.

reference_evidence_units.quote: More interestingly, in aprotic solvents, the ISC times are prolonged (1154 ps in DMF, 1887 ps in trichloroethylene) with the decreasing polarity, while the triplet decay shortens to 1.268 and 0.453 μs.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2

reference_evidence_units.quote: In contrast, in protic solvents (methanol and ethanol), ISC lifetimes significantly accelerated to 34.29 and 92.07 ps, accompanied by shortened triplet lifetimes (0.3053 and 0.3591 μs).
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hydrogen-bonding solvents speed ISC to tens of ps.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The spectral component of 1.584 ps reflects the decay of the initial ESA signal at 590 nm together with the rise of the ICT-related ESA signal at 540 nm and is therefore assigned to the ICT process.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2
reference_evidence_units.statement: An ICT state forms in 1.6 ps before ISC.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Compared with BVI-OH, which shows an emission maximum at 439 nm, BVI-NO2 and BVI-MN display obvious red-shifted emission bands located at 624 and 615 nm, respectively, supporting the formation of CT states in these two molecules.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BVI-NO2

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: An ICT state forms in 1.6 ps and precedes ISC; red-shifted CT emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Heavy-atom-free ISC via the nitro group (S1 pi-pi* to T4 n-pi*): triplet absorption and microsecond triplets by fs/ns-TA; ISC time tuned by solvent polarity and hydrogen bonding.
